description: §42.4: `if (a)` on `string | not` and `n ? 1 : 0` on `int | not` are presence tests — admitted, no E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN.
rationale: §42.4 statement 2: "A condition that is, as a WHOLE (parentheses aside), a value of type `T | not` (`T` not `bool`) SHALL test presence". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
